title: RANK functions require a reference-producing ref, accept spelled logical text in order, and #NAME? in compat-1
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, RANK, RANK.EQ, and RANK.AVG reject non-reference literals/arrays in the second argument at formula entry, coerce number before checking ref errors or order, equate -0.0 and +0.0, and accept spelled logical strings ("TRUE"/"FALSE", case-insensitive, without leading spaces) for order while rejecting numeric text such as "1" with #VALUE!. Under compatibility version 1, @RANK.AVG and @RANK.EQ evaluate to #NAME?.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (rows 194-196) and rank_coerces_number_before_validating_order controls, and matched across 2,810/2,810 RANK, 2,812/2,812 RANK.AVG, and 2,811/2,811 RANK.EQ full-bank rows.
